notes: The step canvas Pip's rewrite produced in production on 25 Nov 2026 for the owner's eleven-step request, in English stand-in form: the step names, their order, the outcomes and the ways out are as the founder described them (step 1's outcome about phone type, Login before the install, Android and iPhone install, Login again with Password issues and no outcome, Enter Expense, Finalise the call, then Call back and End call as steps of their own; Language, My Farms, First sale, Dashboard and Not registered missing; many ways out to the call-back and end steps). The lines and instructions are not in the evidence and are written in its shape as English glosses keyed en-IN.

script.opening_line: Hello {{lead_name}}, this is Varsha from Rytu Khata, calling to help you start using the Rytu Khata app you registered for. Can you talk now?

stages.name: Introduction
stages.instruction: Ask which phone they use, Android or iPhone, and explain that the app is installed from the website.

scripts.en-IN: Which phone do you use, Android or iPhone?

branches.when: They say it is the wrong number

stages.name: Login
stages.instruction: Ask them to log in with their mobile number.

scripts.en-IN: Please log in with your mobile number.

stages.name: Android install
stages.instruction: On Android, ask them to open rytukhata.com in Chrome and press Install app.

scripts.en-IN: Open rytukhata.com in Chrome and press Install app.

stages.name: iPhone install
stages.instruction: On iPhone, ask them to open rytukhata.com in Safari, tap Share and then Add to Home Screen.

scripts.en-IN: Open rytukhata.com in Safari and tap Share.

stages.name: Login
stages.instruction: Ask them to open the installed app and log in.

scripts.en-IN: Now open the app and log in.

stages.name: Password issues
stages.instruction: Ask them to use the code sent to their mobile number to log in.

scripts.en-IN: Please use the code that came to your mobile.

stages.name: Enter Expense
stages.instruction: Ask them to enter one expense in the app.

scripts.en-IN: Now enter one expense in the app.

stages.name: Finalise the call
stages.instruction: Read back what they did, thank them and close the call.

scripts.en-IN: Thank you, you can call us any time.

stages.name: Call back
stages.instruction: Ask when suits them for a call back.

scripts.en-IN: When shall we call you back?

stages.name: End call
stages.instruction: Thank them and end the call.

scripts.en-IN: Thank you, have a good day.

step_outcomes.outcome: The caller has confirmed their phone type and understood the installation method.
The app is installed on the caller's phone.
The caller has entered one expense.
